name: Buchanan Day Camp
description_short: Six week village day camp for children entering kindergarten to 8th grade, open to residents and non-residents, run in two three week sessions from 9 to 3. Mornings include swim lessons at the village pool, afternoons free swim, with art, field sports, gaga and special guests; after care runs to 6.
swim_waterfront_notes: Swim lessons each morning by a WSI and lifeguard staff and afternoon free swim at the village pool; every camper is swim assessed in the first two days. A signed swim permission slip is required.
refund_policy_summary: No refunds, including for weather cancellations. Full payment is due at registration.
notes: Non-resident prices: 3 weeks $523, 6 weeks $996 ($471 and $898 for a sibling). Village of Buchanan residents (ZIP 10511) pay $355 and $660 ($320 and $576 for a sibling); residents show two proofs of residency. No camp July 3. Sessions cannot be split. Registration opened March 2, 2026. The page says 2027 information goes up in February 2027.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Buchanan Day Camp 2026 registration PDF: June 29 to August 7, 2026, two 3 week sessions, 9 to 3, after care 3 to 6 (price not printed), grades K to 8, residents and non-residents. Non-resident rate used; resident rate in notes. The PDF gives no street address for the camp (it uses the Village of Buchanan Day Camp pool); ZIP 10511 is the village ZIP the PDF names for residents. The PDF also prints 914-229-8391 once; 914-293-8391 appears three times and is used. Ages derived from grades.
